entry:un-ai.note: Link resolves to the Panel site. Res. 79/325 adopted 26 Aug 2025 sets up a 40-member Panel and an annual Dialogue. Co-chairs are Bengio and Ressa. The Preliminary Report came out 1 Jul 2026 and the first thematic brief (agents, loss of control) 21 Sep 2026. The first Dialogue met in Geneva on 6-7 Jul 2026; the next is in New York, 3-4 May 2027, and the Dialogue alternates between Geneva and New York. The Panel gives up to two updates a year to the GA plenary and presents its annual report at the Dialogue, plus thematic briefs as it deems necessary. pow 1 matches peer L1 science bodies (aisr); status active.
